``` **Header Element ID:** `#main-header` **Root Class:** `.no-header` (BEM pattern) **Key DOM classes:** `no-header__inner`, `no-header__container`, `no-header__wrap`, `no-header__logo`, `no-header__menu-btn`, `no-header-right` ### 2. **Header SCSS Rules** **File:** `/resource/scss/layouts/_header.scss` Current header styling uses: - **Default state:** `background: transparent`, `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--clr-border-default)` - **Transition:** `transition: var(--transition-default)` applied to root element - **.visual modifier class:** Activates semi-transparent background with backdrop blur: ```scss &.visual { background: var(--clr-surface-weak); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(2px); } ``` - **When drawer open (.is-open):** - On `.visual.is-open`: `background: var(--clr-background-active)` - On `.no-header__inner`: `border-color: var(--clr-border-default)` **Key backdrop properties:** - `backdrop-filter: blur(2px)` (standard) - `-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(2px)` (Safari support) ### 3. **TypeScript Header Controller** **File:** `/resource/ts/ui/Header.ts` The Header class currently handles **drawer toggle only**, NOT scroll events: - Manages drawer visibility state with `.is-open` class - Binds to `[data-drawer-trigger]` button - Syncs `aria-expanded` attribute - Handles Escape key and outside clicks **Important:** There is **NO existing scroll listener** in the Header class. The header does not currently listen for scroll events or toggle a "scrolled" state. ### 4. **Lenis Scroll API & Event System** **File:** `/resource/ts/lib/lenis/LenisRuntime.ts` **Lenis instance access:** ```typescript window.__appLenis // Global Lenis instance reference ``` **Lenis instance properties:** - `actualScroll`: Current actual scroll position - `animatedScroll`: Current animated scroll position - `targetScroll`: Target scroll position - `raf(time: number)`: RAF callback - `scrollTo(target, options?)`: Programmatic scroll **Lenis setup:** - Uses manual RAF loop (not auto RAF): `autoRaf: false` - Smooth wheel enabled: `smoothWheel: true` - Config in `/resource/ts/config/timeline.config.js` - Lenis instance stored at `(window as WindowWithLenis).__appLenis` **Current scroll listeners in the app:** - `ScrollSceneRuntime.ts` — scroll-triggered scene/timeline activation - `LenisRuntime.ts` — native scroll sync - `ObserveManager.ts` — scroll listener - `QaManager.ts` — scroll viewport tracking - `Button.ts` — scroll listener - `WorksPageRuntime.ts` — page-specific scroll **No existing "is-scrolled" pattern** — No components currently toggle a scroll state class on the header. ### 5. **AppManager Scroll Event Wiring** **File:** `/resource/ts/manager/AppManager.ts` The AppManager does **NOT wire scroll events to the header**. Instead: - **ScrollSceneRuntime** handles scroll-triggered activations (lines 1547-1617) - Creates scene progress handlers that sync 3D scenes and animations - Manages intro flow scroll state - No direct header scroll event binding **DOM config reference:** ```typescript // From /resource/ts/config/dom.config.ts export const DOM_CONFIG: DomConfig = { keys: { header: "#main-header", // ... }, drawer: { /* drawer config */ }, }; ``` ### 6. **Key Findings & Architecture** | Aspect | Current State | |--------|---------------| | **Header scroll listener** | ❌ Does not exist | | **"is-scrolled" class toggle** | ❌ Not implemented | | **"scrolled" class toggle** | ❌ Not implemented | | **"visual" class** | ✅ Already defined in SCSS (backdrop blur) | | **Backdrop-filter** | ✅ Already coded in `.visual` state | | **Lenis integration** | ✅ Global instance at `window.__appLenis` | | **Scroll event architecture** | ✅ Uses RAF-based ScrollSceneRuntime | | **Header transitions** | ✅ `var(--transition-default)` already applied | ### 7. **Lenis Event Subscription Pattern** The project does NOT use Lenis event emitters. Instead: - **RAF loop** in LenisRuntime continuously calls `instance.raf(time)` - Scroll position is read directly from instance properties - External listeners attach to native `window.scroll` event - ScrollSceneRuntime polls element positions during scroll **To subscribe to scroll in this architecture:** ```typescript window.addEventListener("scroll", () => { const lenis = (window as WindowWithLenis).__appLenis; const scrollY = lenis?.actualScroll ?? window.scrollY; // Update header state }, { passive: true }); ``` --- ### Summary The header currently has: - ✅ Fixed positioning with proper z-index layering - ✅ `.visual` modifier class with backdrop blur (2px) already coded - ✅ `transition: var(--transition-default)` for smooth changes - ✅ Drawer toggle logic bound to menu button - ❌ **No scroll listener to trigger the `.visual` class** - ❌ **No "scrolled" or "is-scrolled" class mechanism** To add scroll-triggered backdrop effect, you would need to attach a scroll listener to the header element and toggle the `.visual` class based on scroll position.
